duty: INTENT = chat prose before tools (never fenced, never Shell). OBJECTIVE=postcondition; tag edit:path|NEW:path; Done-when ≤5 decidable predicates; finish every tag this turn; no drip; then HANDOFF. Cursor edits: Write|StrReplace only — never Shell to write code. ponytail_ladder: PONYTAIL LADDER (stop at first rung that holds; skip a rung → justify in 1 line): 1.No-code 2.Reuse(Grep codebase) 3.Stdlib 4.Platform-native 5.Installed-dep 6.One-line 7.Minimum(<80 LOC/file; soft warn 120; hard 300; legacy >700 emergency subatomic split). SUBATOMIC: one job per file, small surface, no god-files — Write new modules + StrReplace original; prefer deletion over wrappers. ANTI-BLOAT: zero prose comments (lean_gate comment_ratio_max=2).
